review_scope: Brick base, charcoal front bay and mushroom upper exterior revision; low roof edge clarity. Not full functional, dimensional, engineering or client approval.
renderer: Blender 4.5.14 LTS / Cycles Metal / 320 samples / AgX Medium High Contrast / exposure 0
plan_review_provenance: Retained previously pixel-reviewed PNG/SVG plans; hashes unchanged. Occupied footprints, room layout, floor elevations and opening schedule were not altered by this exterior finish/low-roof-edge revision.
visual_review: All eight new final images inspected as actual pixels. Front bay and gable are continuous charcoal without brick cheeks or a red inter-storey seam; lower entry/garage connectors are brick. Mushroom upper fields wrap around the rear and outer garage end, with a softer warm gray appearance in sunlight and shade. Low study roof edge is slimmer and aligned with its wall, positive fall retained, no occupied terrace implied. Supported outer garage gable and dark soffit retained. Interiors remain furnishing studies with unfinished trim/reveal junctions and incomplete operating-clearance review. Landscaping remains schematic and the broad pale apron/source roof proportions are unresolved styling limitations.

independent_reviews.findings: Full charcoal bay including gable and returns; red seam and white vertical strips removed. Coherent brick base/upper volumes. Supported garage gable preserved. Low roof edge reads as roof perimeter; no blocking defect within this revision scope.

independent_reviews.stage: Actual native drafts compared with previous outputs
independent_reviews.findings: Mushroom visibly softer/darker than prior cream in front/detail; rear/court shade remains warm neutral gray without obvious pink, yellow or green shift. Coherent charcoal/brick family; no blocking palette defect within this revision scope.
